question: Can the AI Storyteller's failure, limit and redirect moments play in the cast's live voices with no network, so a failure is a performance and never silence?
why: Lane D, finish sprint (docs/plans/2026-11-15-finish-ai-storyteller.md, stages 1 and 2): every failure gets an in-story outcome, and the app owns the ending even when the AI or the voices are down. These lines are played from the headset, so they can't be voiced live.
sameAcrossJobs: OpenAI text to speech directly (gpt-4o-mini-tts, not Runway, not ElevenLabs: owner, Nov 16), with art/voice/live.json's voice and instructions per speaker, so they match the live lines exactly. mp3, levelled like run 010 into art/sound/storyteller/.
decideBy: Each clip decodes, is levelled, and is under 6 s.
The owner hears them on the Quest's speakers in headset session B, beside live lines from the same voices (approved first, in the Nov 16 session).
learnEvenIfRejected: Whether gpt-4o-mini-tts holds a character's voice the same across a prepared line and a live one, given the same voice and instructions.
reusableOutput: art/sound/storyteller/: the Storyteller's recorded lines, played by id from client/src/storyteller/ for each failure outcome.
estimateNote: 712 characters with OpenAI's gpt-4o-mini-tts: about 60 s of audio, roughly $0.02 at OpenAI's published prices ($0.60 per 1M text tokens, $12 per 1M audio tokens). No Runway credits: lane D's 40-credit budget is untouched.
capNote: Covers a second take of every line.
status: recorded Nov 17 (sprint master approved the four live voices for the owner, on the live voice proof): 13 lines, 712 of 2,000 characters, about $0.016; see results.md
